headline: NYSE picks Avalanche to settle tokenized stocks

scenes.vo: The New York Stock Exchange just picked a public blockchain to settle tokenized stocks. Here's what changed.
On Monday, Ava Labs said Avalanche will be the core ledger for clearing and settling trades on an upcoming N Y S E linked tokenized stock platform, built for trading around the clock.
Here's why traders are watching it. The biggest stock exchange in the world is putting real settlement on a public chain. CoinDesk says the token rose about eight percent in a day.
The catch? Nothing is live yet. The platform still needs regulatory approval, and the release gives no launch date.
Here's what happens next. Watch for the regulatory sign off, a confirmed launch date, and which stocks get tokenized first.
